cues.en: I want to address a question that you may or may not have, but it's something that's taken me years
cues.zh: 想回答一個你可能有、也可能沒想過的問題，但我花了好多年

cues.en: to understand, and that is why not just have everything as global variables.
cues.zh: 才理解：為什麼不全部用全域變數？

cues.en: I mean, all this confusion of who has access to who.
cues.zh: 誰能存取誰，搞得這麼混亂。

cues.en: How easy would it be if everything was just on the main page?
cues.zh: 如果全部放在主頁面，不是很簡單？

cues.en: All our information, all the data on our global scope so that everything has access to everything, wouldn't that be easier?
cues.zh: 所有資訊、所有資料都在全域，每個地方都能存取所有東西，不是比較容易？

cues.en: And you'd be kind of right.
cues.zh: 某種程度上，你是對的。

cues.en: I mean, that would make all this headache go away, right?
cues.zh: 這樣頭痛的問題都消失了，對吧？

cues.en: But you have to remember that machines don't have infinite power, don't have infinite CPU, don't have infinite memory.
cues.zh: 但記得，機器不是無限強，CPU、記憶體也不是無限。

cues.en: They all have limited resources.
cues.zh: 資源都有限。

cues.en: And as programmers, we have to be conscious of what resources we use, because sometimes that can cost us money, sometimes they can crash our computers.
cues.zh: 身為程式設計師，必須留意使用的資源，有時會花錢，有時可能讓電腦當機。

cues.en: And scope is a great demonstration of this.
cues.zh: 作用域就是個很好的示範。

cues.en: For example, this code right here, when this function is run, we're creating technically just one
cues.zh: 例如這段程式，執行函式時，依講者簡化說法，只替 x 建立一個

cues.en: location in memory for the X variable.
cues.zh: 記憶體位置。

cues.en: So we have that bookshelf in our computer that is X that's pointing to local when we actually call this function.
cues.zh: 呼叫函式時，有一格叫 x 的書架，指向 local。

cues.en: And then when we say non-local here, well, we're saying just don't create another bookshelf for us.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 nonlocal，意思是不要再建立另一格，

cues.en: Just use the one that we already have and assign it non-local.
cues.zh: 沿用已有的，指定為 nonlocal。

cues.en: If we didn't have this line, by the time we get to line seven, we've placed in memory x equals to local and x equals to non-local.
cues.zh: 沒有這一行，到第七行時，記憶體裡有 x='local' 和 x='nonlocal'，

cues.en: So we have two locations now in memory.
cues.zh: 就有兩個位置。

cues.en: Now this isn't a big deal because well, in this day and age we do have a lot of memory.
cues.zh: 現在不是大問題，因為現代電腦記憶體很多。

cues.en: But as programs get larger and larger, this does become a bit of a problem.
cues.zh: 但程式越大，可能就成為問題。

cues.en: OC But what about a function?
cues.zh: 那函式呢？

cues.en: I mean, we learn that functions allow us to not repeat ourselves and being able to call out or multiple times.
cues.zh: 學過函式讓我們不用重複撰寫，可以多次呼叫 outer。

cues.en: But another good use of functions is that once we call this function and all of this is done, the computer
cues.zh: 函式另一個好處，是呼叫完、所有工作結束後，電腦，

cues.en: and the python interpreter specifically destroys all this memory.
cues.zh: 特別是 Python 直譯器，能回收不再需要的記憶體。

cues.en: That is, once we finish with the outer function, I can't really call print x here.
cues.zh: 也就是 outer 執行完，不能直接在外面 print(x)。

cues.en: It's going to give me an error.
cues.zh: 會出錯，

cues.en: It's going to say, I have no idea what X is and why is that?
cues.zh: 說不知道 x 是什麼。為什麼？

cues.en: It's because after we call this function, the python, what we call the garbage collector, is going to say, hey, it looks like we're done with this function.
cues.zh: 講者用垃圾回收說明：函式呼叫完，Python 的垃圾回收機制看到，這個函式已經完成，

cues.en: And I see that this X variable well in this X variable we're not going to use because we're done with this function.
cues.zh: x 也不再需要，因為函式已結束，

cues.en: So I'm going to collect that garbage and then just throw it out.
cues.zh: 就會收集這些垃圾，把它們清掉。

cues.en: So I'm going to empty that memory cupboard so that other resources or other programs can use that.
cues.zh: 清空記憶體櫥櫃，讓其他資源或程式使用。

cues.en: And that is a really nice feature where Python just automatically removes these for you so that you don't clog up the computer's memory.
cues.zh: 這是很好的功能，Python 自動替你移除不再使用的內容，避免占滿記憶體。

cues.en: And that's why scope is useful.
cues.zh: 所以作用域很有用。

cues.en: We don't have to think about it in such detail like I've mentioned it, but it's nice to know that it's there so that your programs don't hog up a lot of memory and they can run efficiently.
cues.zh: 不需要像我這樣想得很細，但知道有這個機制，能讓程式不過度占用記憶體、有效率執行。

cues.en: This is a bit of an advance topic, but I did want to include it in here so that you can think about why programs are designed the way they are.
cues.zh: 這比較進階，但還是想介紹，讓你思考程式為什麼這樣設計。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I'm going to stop talking now.
cues.zh: 先不說了。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 下支影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
